description: This is the main entry point of a React frontend application. It initializes the React app by rendering the App component inside the 'root' DOM element, utilizing ReactDOM's createRoot and render methods, and wraps the application in React.StrictMode for development checks.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root React node for rendering the app into the DOM.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot().render
methods.description: Renders React components into the DOM at the specified root.
